title: docxaudit: find what your converter silently dropped from a .docx
description: Reads the raw OOXML of a Word document and reports the conversion failures that ship unnoticed: a table collapsed to zero width, an orphaned image, a supplement whose page count no longer matches the PDF. Exits non-zero, so it drops into a manuscript pipeline.
